summary: Factor by factor (IsAdmissibleComb.pure): τ_N of a pair of translated vacua is a sum over y of root-of-unity multiples of translated vacua.

steps.claim: By IsAdmissibleComb.pure it suffices that each factor τ_N(translateDatum(t, 2i) ⊗ translateDatum(t, 2i + 1)) is an admissible combination of the tensors ϱ_f(x₁)vac ⊗ ϱ_f(x₂)vac.
steps.lean:
apply IsAdmissibleComb.pure (α := (D.X ·.succ × _ → _)) (v := fun i x ↦
    heisFinPart _ x.1 _ ⊗ₜ heisFinPart _ x.2 _)

steps.claim: It is the sum over the y with coefficients 1 (of_sum: denominator 1, size the number of y, at most N^{f·n_m}); each term is a root of unity times ϱ_f(x₁)vac ⊗ ϱ_f(x₂)vac with x the sum of the translation and t (finHeisOp_finHeisOp), re-indexed by of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul; it remains that x is admissible for qN.
steps.lean:
refine .of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul (congr(∑ _, $(one_smul ..)).subst (.of_sum (by simp) (by
    simp_intro .. [↓card_X, ← pow_mul, card_piPlaces]; gcongr; exacts [D.le_of_hasLogBound,
      D.n_mono (by grind)]))) fun y _ ↦ ⟨_, (isOfFinOrder_ψf _).mul (isOfFinOrder_ψf _), (_, _), ?_,
    .trans (by apply congrArg₂ <;> ext1 <;> apply finHeisOp_finHeisOp) (smul_tmul_smul ..)⟩

steps.claim: At a place w not dividing qN the entries of x are those of t (the residue part lives above N), integral by ht.
steps.lean:
constructor <;> intro i w <;> simp_intro e [w.2.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem,
    D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.natCast_mem_iff] <;> simpa [e, apply_ite, ite_apply] using ht _ i w e.1
